# cash denomination calculator

> Free, private, multi-currency cash denomination counter and bill-splitting tool for retail cashiers, bank tellers, and accounting teams.

## Core Capabilities
- **Mode 1: Cash Counter & Tally**: Real-time multiplication of banknote and coin quantities, calculating subtotals, physical piece counts, grand total, and legal text conversion (amount in words).
- **Mode 2: Split Amount (Cash Breakdown)**: Greedy coin-change optimization algorithm that splits any entered target balance into the absolute minimum count of bills and coins for payroll envelopes and petty cash.
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Pre-configured denomination presets for USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), SAR (ر.س), AED (د.إ), EGP (ج.م), KWD (د.ك), and INR (₹).
- **Audit Slips & Export**: Instant export to CSV spreadsheet, one-click clipboard text copy, and print-ready formal bank deposit audit slips.
- **Zero Data Logging**: 100% client-side computing inside browser memory; no numbers, tallies, or register amounts are stored or transmitted.

## Primary Pages & Documentation
- [/](https://yourdomain.com/): The main interactive cash denomination calculator and bill breakdown application.
- [/about.html](https://yourdomain.com/about.html): Algorithmic specifications (Greedy vs Dynamic Programming), float sanitization methods, and end-of-day till reconciliation SOP.
- [/privacy.html](https://yourdomain.com/privacy.html): Zero-knowledge privacy architecture, local storage policies, and audit data isolation guarantees.

## Algorithmic Formulation
- Direct Tally: `Total = SUM(Count_i * Denomination_i)`
- Greedy Split: `Count_i = floor(Remaining_Balance / Denomination_i)`, iterated in descending face-value order.
